speaker: Devotee (longing to see)
question: What may we see?
premises: May we see the deep, supreme-light-circled, darkness-wiped, lovely.
Dwell within your cave.
inference: May we see the lovely deep, and dwell within your cave.

option_choices.reason: Governs bhavadguhām (dwell within your cave); vocative would orphan the cave accusative.

speaker: Devotee (praising seers)
question: To whom homage — even dream-seers?
premises: Homage to them even: who see the moon-crescent-crowned lord even in dream.
The giver of supreme bliss.
inference: Homage to those who see the bliss-giving lord even in dreams.

speaker: Devotee (asking)
question: What desire is pleasing?
premises: O Blessed — be! — the desire to contemplate your-being-ish being.
Skilled at cutting rebirth-fear: to whom is it not pleasing?
inference: The desire to contemplate being pleases all, cutting rebirth-fear.
uncertainties: bhāvatkaṃ: GRETIL bhāvatkam+bhāvam; Vṛtti M00089 glosses bhāvātkaṃ bhāvaṃ as cidānandaghana tvatsvarūpa (pleonastic -ka vs corruption still open, morph flagged).

option_choices.reason: Injunction sequence be! then contemplate (bhāvayituṃ); vocative would duplicate bhagavan address.
GRETIL pada kept as your-being-ish; Vṛtti glosses as your dense consciousness-bliss nature (tvatsvarūpa).

speaker: Devotee (resolving)
question: What shall be lifelong duty?
premises: Lifelong, O world-lord: this be our task — by your grace.
Staying with single-pointed mind on you alone.
inference: Our lifelong task: staying single-pointed on you by your grace.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — thousand-branch tree?
premises: Self made of thousand-branch-spread Veda and Āgama.
Bow to Śambhu, endless-fruit wish-tree.
inference: Bow to Śambhu, Veda-embodied wish-tree of endless fruit.

speaker: Devotee (hoping)
question: How might we become pair-free?
premises: Having entrusted speech-mind-body acts in you, O Lord.
Having become you-made, pair-free: may we be even, at any time?
inference: Entrusting all acts in you, may we become you-made and pair-free.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — creation appointments?
premises: In worlds' creation-dissolution-appointments for each welfare.
Possessing independent power needing nothing else: to trident-bearer — bow.
inference: Bow to the trident-bearer of independent power in all cosmic tasks.

speaker: Devotee (reasoning)
question: What fruit by other supports?
premises: Of past-guṇa-yoga's chief meditation-object, of Dhūrjaṭi: even the name.
Of meditators, by meditations — what fruit by other supports?
inference: Dhūrjaṭi's name alone outdoes all meditations; other supports are fruitless.

option_choices.reason: Form is genitive (of Dhūrjaṭi, agreeing with chief-object); address sense carried in L2, form kept honest.

speaker: Devotee (praising)
question: Who are praiseworthy?
premises: Bow, bow — 'to Śiva' thus said: by mantra-power taking refuge.
Praiseworthy they, striving to enjoy Śāmbhavī fortune.
inference: Praiseworthy are those striving for Śāmbhavī fortune by mantra-power.

option_choices.reason: Demonstrative te … ya (those … who strive); T1 enclitic misread corrected with revised flag.

speaker: Devotee (marveling)
question: What path, word, meditation is not you?
premises: What path by which unattainable? What speech by which unspoken?
What meditation by which unmeditated? What — what are you not, O Lord?
inference: Every path, word, and meditation reaches you; you are all.
